title: Finite projection of the ordinary quotient pullback mate
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, arbitrary schemes X,Y and f:X→Y, an OrdinaryLimitModel a [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge] and a normalized strict Pull presentation p [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison]. For any unbounded completed-coefficient complex P on Y and n≥0, put R=f*P termwise, C=f*_seq(red_Y(P)) termwise, and Z=Res(C) as a complex of towers. Let b:R→lim(Z) be the ordinary reduction/limit adjunction unit on R, followed by the ordinary limit of a.reductionPullComplex(f,P) and the canonical complex-of-composite comparison. Then b followed by the nth termwise limit projection and the nth component of pullbackTensorPullbackTower(f,P) [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations] equals the nth quotient augmentation of R [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] followed by the nth component of p.tower on P. This is an equality of cochain maps before derived localization; P need not be K-flat or complete.

proof.text: Apply the sectionwise projection identity in each cochain degree and at every site section. Homological-complex extensionality then gives the equality of cochain maps.

The unit normalizations of the ordinary reduction evaluation and inverse-image evaluation cancel their inverses in pullbackTensorPullbackTower. The projected mate sends the integral pullback unit of x to the finite pullback unit of 1 tensor x. Use the already proved section normalization in scalarReductionExtension_adjunction to identify the finite scalar unit with the sheafified section 1 tensor x.

By the prescribed augmentation formula and p.generators, the other composite has the same values. The ordinary pullback Hom bijection and sectionwise extensionality prove equality in each degree, hence equality of cochain maps. All formulas apply to empty schemes, zero complexes, exponent one and identities.

theorem pullQuotientOrdinaryProjection
    (a : IntegralSystemRealization.OrdinaryLimitModel l E)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : OpenFactorCoherence.Pull l E f)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    let R := (OpenFactorCoherence.pullCx l E f).obj P
    let C := ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    let Z := ((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C
    ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryAdjunction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app R ≫
        ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryLimit l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (a.reductionPullComplex l E f P) ≫
        (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
          (Iso.refl (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X ⋙
            pullbackTensorConstantLimit l E X)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app C ≫
        (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (lim.π (op n)) (.up ℤ)).app Z ≫
        (pullbackTensorPullbackTower l E f P).hom.app (op n) =
      ((IntegralOnSlice.augmentation l E X none).app R).app (op n) ≫
        (p.tower.hom.app P).app (op n)
